component.name: PainelLateral
component.script: sub init() m.painel = m.top.findNode("painel") m.lista = m.top.findNode("lista") m.lista.observeField("itemSelected", "onItem") m.top.findNode("focoTimer").observeField("fire", "aplicarFoco") end sub sub onOpcoes() raiz = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") for each o in m.top.opcoes n = raiz.CreateChild("ContentNode") n.title = o.titulo if o.detalhe <> invalid then n.description = o.detalhe end for m.lista.content = raiz end sub sub onAberto() m.top.findNode("tituloLabel").text = m.top.titulo m.painel.visible = m.top.aberto if m.top.aberto then t = m.top.findNode("focoTimer") t.control = "start" end if end sub sub aplicarFoco() m.lista.setFocus(true) end sub sub onItem() m.top.escolhido = m.lista.itemSelected end sub function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false if key = "back" or key = "left" then m.top.aberto = false return true end if return true end function
